name: Biological Sciences PhD

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application complete
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated program deadline, earlier than central general dates.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic fee $45. Central instructions explicitly say international fees will not be waived. Automatic category waivers include McNair, US military veterans, returned Peace Corps volunteers and currently employed US K–12 public-school teachers.

english.note: Central FAQ suggests these scores and PTE53; no MyBest TOEFL. Program requires scores within two years. Country-list citizenship/degree exemptions apply; program education route specifies at least two university years. Confirm exemption with Graduate Admissions.

documents: Transcripts from all institutions; final official degree-granting transcripts upon admission
Statement of purpose, maximum 500 words, with research experience, goals and three potential advisors
CV with research roles/methods/outcomes, publications/presentation abstracts and relevant experience
Master’s thesis abstract (working draft allowed if degree in progress)
requirements.note: MS or MA must be completed before the PhD starts, preferably Biology or related field. Contact prospective faculty before applying and identify three faculty interests. Indicate whether seeking assistantship in application. Central GRE is not required but defers to program; current Biology guidelines do not give an explicit GRE rule, so confirm.

funding.note: Competitive TA stipends normally cover nine months with instructional and nonresident fee waiver. PhD eligibility up to four years; renewal requires GPA3.2, satisfactory duties and progress. Summer support depends on budget and progress. No all-student funding guarantee established.

timeline.decisions: Assistantship decisions usually finalized by June 1 (undated program guidance).
